build_transformer_encoder: build a Transformer_Encoder module with model_dim, nhead, and num_layers for video feature encoding
create_positional_embedding: create a PositionalEmbedding module with configurable d_model and max_seq_len for sinusoidal positional encoding
run_transformer_forward: run the Transformer_Encoder forward pass with batched features and segment length tensors
create_padding_mask: create a segment padding mask from segment lengths using the create_mask method
review_transformer_encoder_forward: review the Transformer_Encoder forward method that reshapes features, applies positional encoding, and projects through the summary head
